title: 2dcat
description: Puts a set of images into an image matrix montage of NX by NY images.

scale_image.description: Multiply each image in the output image matrix by the color or intensity of the pixel in the scale image.
scale_image.title: Scale Image

scale_pixels.description: Multiply each pixel in the output image by the color or intensity of the pixel in the scale image. The scale image is resized to the output image's resolution.
scale_pixels.title: Scale Pixels

scale_intensity.description: Use the intensity (average color) of the pixel instead of its color.
scale_intensity.title: Scale Intensity

rgb_out.description: Force output to be in RGB, even if input is bytes.
rgb_out.title: RGB Out

res_in.description: Set resolution of all input images.
res_in.title: Input Resolution

respad_in.description: Resample to max while respecting the aspect ratio, then pad to desired pixel count.
respad_in.title: Resample and Pad Input

pad_val.description: Set the padding value when using -respad_in. Should be in the range [0, 255], default is 0.
pad_val.title: Padding Value

crop.description: Crop images by specified number of pixels from the left, right, top, and bottom.
crop.title: Crop Pixels

autocrop_ctol.description: Automatically crop lines where RGB values differ by less than the specified percentage from the corner pixel values.
autocrop_ctol.title: Auto Crop Corner Tolerance

autocrop_atol.description: Automatically crop lines where RGB values differ by less than the specified percentage from the line average.
autocrop_atol.title: Auto Crop Average Tolerance

autocrop.description: Automatically crop lines with default tolerances using both autocrop_atol and autocrop_ctol set to 20.
autocrop.title: Auto Crop

zero_wrap.description: Use solid black images if not enough images are provided to fill the matrix.
zero_wrap.title: Zero Wrap

white_wrap.description: Use solid white images if not enough images are provided to fill the matrix.
white_wrap.title: White Wrap

gray_wrap.description: Use solid gray images if not enough images are provided to fill the matrix. The gray value must be between 0 and 1.0.
gray_wrap.title: Gray Wrap

image_wrap.description: Reuse images to fill the matrix. This is the default behavior.
image_wrap.title: Image Wrap

rand_wrap.description: Randomize the order of images when reusing to fill the matrix.
rand_wrap.title: Random Wrap

prefix.description: Prefix the output file names with the specified string.
prefix.title: Output Prefix

matrix.description: Specify the number of images in each row (NX) and column (NY) of the image matrix.
matrix.title: Matrix Dimensions

nx.description: Specify the number of images in each row.
nx.title: Number of Images in Each Row

ny.description: Specify the number of images in each column.
ny.title: Number of Images in Each Column

matrix_from_scale.description: Set matrix dimensions NX and NY to be the same as the SCALE_IMG's dimensions. Requires the -scale_image option.
matrix_from_scale.title: Matrix from Scale

gap.description: Put a gap of specified pixels between images.
gap.title: Gap Size

gap_col.description: Set color of the gap line to specified R, G, B values. Values range from 0 to 255.
gap_col.title: Gap Color
